title: Tunat`Muram Cuu Vauax
summary: Defeat Tunat's doppelganger, then face a second body that borrows the powers of earlier Tacvi bosses.
overview: Defeat Tunat's doppelganger, then face a second body that borrows the powers of earlier Tacvi bosses.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign leaders to call each borrowed form and carry add-control plans from the preceding bosses into the finale.

phases.label: Doppelganger
phases.description: Handle the living phylacteries and the ukun that activate at 40%.

phases.label: Borrowed powers
phases.description: Adapt to the previous bosses in health-band order.

phases.label: Tunat revealed
phases.description: Finish the true form through haste, rage and overlapping spells.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The first body's room seals at 90%; its ukun activate at 40%. Killing it immediately reveals the second body.
The second body changes at 90%, 80%, 70%, 60%, 50%, 40% and 30%, reproducing Xxeric, Kretv, Riel, Kvxe, Yihst, Mordl and Shaldn mechanics.
These phases mix hatchlings, unstable constructs, timed power gains, charm pressure, split images and rage.
At 20%, Tunat returns to his own form with haste, rage and additional spell timers.

notes: Approval E333. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
